issues.quote: It would have been very quick, Inspector.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no duration for anything after the 10:45 departure or any time of death. Its only clock readings are the nine o'clock watch check, the ten o'clock salon clock, and the 10:45 watch reading.
issues.misreading: A solver could read 'very quick' as a hint that the blow was struck and death followed almost at once, which narrows the time window for the murder to a few moments near a particular clock reading. The sheet supports no such duration.

issues.quote: But the regulator stopped with its master, and I think that is the truest thing anyone will say tonight.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about any clock stopping. Its only clock facts are the watch two minutes fast, the salon clock at 9:55 when the bell struck ten, and the 10:45 watch reading.
issues.misreading: A solver could take the stopped regulator as a time-of-death marker, or as evidence that a particular clock was halted at the moment of the killing. Either reading would supply a clock reading the sheet does not give.

issues.quote: Aurèle's repeater was in his hand.
issues.fact: The sheet does not mention a repeater, where Aurèle's watch was at the time of death, or any object in his hand.
issues.misreading: A repeater chimes the time on demand, so a solver could take its presence in his hand as an implied time reading, or as a whereabouts clue placing the watch with the body.

issues.quote: I should think the mallet you have already found on the floor.
issues.fact: The sheet does not mention the mallet or where it was found.
issues.misreading: The sentence gives a location for the weapon that the sheet does not supply, which a solver could treat as a whereabouts fact.

issues.quote: He would have wanted to be the first to strike the new century, and he would have wanted you to hear him do it.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no indication that Aurèle intended to strike midnight or any hour other than the stated bell readings.
issues.misreading: The reference to striking the new century, together with the repeater, could suggest a midnight chime and so shift the reader's sense of when events happened.
